tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "A4D89A2F49B4AFC507A5E8B9E8A5417F", "A War has been declared! Citizens of both Settlements are now flagged as combatants and can attack each other without penalties, like Corruption, for the duration of the war.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "1663AFAE4D51DC51A63358A655F64EE3", "Wars are made up of a series of objectives that citizens can help achieve. Whichever Settlement has the most victory points will win the war and reap the benefits.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "76445E434D3F0EDBF8AA6A90CFC3D76F", "Check the status and current objectives of a War in the Citizenship menu. Band together with your fellow citizens and complete War objectives to bring victory to your Settlement!")
